ruleContent.content:
<js>
// 智能呈现起点图数据详情或书评
if (baseUrl.endsWith('/d')) {
    result = java.getString('class.table-responsive@html');
} else if (baseUrl.endsWith('/m')) {
    result = java.getString('class.table-responsive@html');
} else if (baseUrl.match(/\/info\/\d+\/\d+$/)) {
    result = java.getString('class.panel-body@p@html || main p@html');
} else {
    result = java.getString('class.media-body@html') + '\n' + java.getString('class.panel-body.0@html');
}
result = result || '暂无详细内容';
</js>

ruleExplore.name: @css:a[href*="/info/"]@text||h4@text##^\[.*?\]
ruleExplore.author: @css:a[href*="/author/"]@text##\(Lv\.\d+\)|^Lv\.\d+
ruleExplore.coverUrl:
<js>
var href = String(java.getString('@css:a[href*="/info/"]@href') || '');
var m = href.match(/\/info\/(\d+)/);
m ? "https://qidian.qpic.cn/qdbimg/349573/" + m[1] + "/180" : "";
</js>
ruleExplore.kind:
<js>
var str = String(java.getString('td.1@text||td.2@text||td.0@text') || '');
var m = str.match(/\[(.*?)\]/);
m ? m[1] : "";
</js>
ruleExplore.wordCount:
<js>
var r = java.getStringList('td@text');
if(r && r.length >= 5){
var m = String(r).match(/\b\d+(\.\d+)?[万kw]/);
m ? m[0] : "";
}else{
"";
}
</js>
ruleExplore.intro:
<js>
if(baseUrl.includes("booklist/")){
java.getString('class.panel-body@p@html||p@html');
}
else if(baseUrl.includes("shouding/")){
var r=java.getStringList('td@text');
if(r && r.length>=6){
"首订:"+(r[2]||'')+" 收藏:"+(r[3]||'')+" 粉丝:"+(r[6]||'')+"\n收订比:"+(r[4]||'')+" 字数:"+(r[5]||'');
}else{
java.getString('td@text');
}
}
else if(baseUrl.includes("bang/")){
var r=java.getStringList('td@text');
if(r && r.length>=7){
"字数:"+(r[4]||'')+" 收藏:"+(r[5]||'')+" 推荐:"+(r[6]||'');
}else{
java.getString('td@text');
}
}
else if(baseUrl.includes("qianli")){
var r=java.getStringList('td@text');
if(r && r.length>=6){
"评分: "+(r[1]||'')+"  字数: "+(r[4]||'')+"  收藏: "+(r[5]||'');
}else{
java.getString('td@text');
}
}
else if(baseUrl.endsWith("reader/")){
"盟主数: " + java.getString('td.1@text');
}
else if(/rongyao_[45]/.test(baseUrl)){
"粉丝数:" + java.getString('td.2@text') + "\n获得时间:" + java.getString('td.-1@text');
}
else if(baseUrl.includes("twelvekings")){
"粉丝数:" + java.getString('td.3@text') + "\n" + java.getString('td.1@text') + "年";
}
else{
java.getString('td@text');
}
</js>

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var bUrl = (typeof book != "undefined" && book && book.bookUrl) ? book.bookUrl : baseUrl;
var bid = (String(bUrl).match(/\/info\/(\d+)/) || ['', ''])[1];
var list = [];
if (bid) {
    list.push({ title: '📊 综合数据与简介', url: 'https://www.qidiantu.com/info/' + bid });
    list.push({ title: '📈 详细数据分析', url: 'https://www.qidiantu.com/info/' + bid + '/d' });
    list.push({ title: '👑 盟主粉丝榜', url: 'https://www.qidiantu.com/info/' + bid + '/m' });
    for (var p = 1; p <= 5; p++) {
        list.push({ title: '💬 起点书评 (第' + p + '页)', url: 'https://www.qidiantu.com/info/' + bid + '/' + p });
    }
}
result = list;
</js>
